ielts_daily_conversations.description: 雅思日常对话中英对照练习 - 通过看中文写出英文

dialogues.cn: 你好，我叫李明。
dialogues.en: Hello, my name is Li Ming.

dialogues.cn: 很高兴见到你。
dialogues.en: Nice to meet you.

dialogues.cn: 你好吗？
dialogues.en: How are you?

dialogues.cn: 我很好，谢谢。你呢？
dialogues.en: I'm fine, thank you. And you?

dialogues.cn: 我也很好。
dialogues.en: I'm fine too.

dialogues.cn: 早上好！
dialogues.en: Good morning!

dialogues.cn: 下午好！
dialogues.en: Good afternoon!

dialogues.cn: 晚安，明天见。
dialogues.en: Good night, see you tomorrow.

dialogues.cn: 再见！
dialogues.en: Goodbye!

dialogues.cn: 回头见。
dialogues.en: See you later.

dialogues.cn: 这是我的朋友，王芳。
dialogues.en: This is my friend, Wang Fang.

dialogues.cn: 你是哪里人？
dialogues.en: Where are you from?

dialogues.cn: 我来自中国北京。
dialogues.en: I'm from Beijing, China.

dialogues.cn: 你叫什么名字？
dialogues.en: What is your name?

dialogues.cn: 我可以叫你小李吗？
dialogues.en: Can I call you Xiao Li?

dialogues.cn: 你的名字怎么拼写？
dialogues.en: How do you spell your name?

dialogues.cn: 认识你很高兴。
dialogues.en: It's nice to know you.

dialogues.cn: 好久不见！
dialogues.en: Long time no see!

dialogues.cn: 最近怎么样？
dialogues.en: How have you been recently?

dialogues.cn: 还是老样子。
dialogues.en: Same as usual.

dialogues.cn: 你家有几口人？
dialogues.en: How many people are there in your family?

dialogues.cn: 我家有四口人。
dialogues.en: There are four people in my family.

dialogues.cn: 我有一个哥哥和一个妹妹。
dialogues.en: I have an older brother and a younger sister.

dialogues.cn: 我父母都是老师。
dialogues.en: My parents are both teachers.

dialogues.cn: 你有兄弟姐妹吗？
dialogues.en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?

dialogues.cn: 我是独生子女。
dialogues.en: I'm an only child.

dialogues.cn: 我奶奶今年八十岁了。
dialogues.en: My grandmother is eighty years old this year.

dialogues.cn: 我的朋友小王是个护士。
dialogues.en: My friend Xiao Wang is a nurse.

dialogues.cn: 我们从小就是好朋友。
dialogues.en: We have been good friends since childhood.

dialogues.cn: 我经常和家人一起吃晚饭。
dialogues.en: I often have dinner with my family.

dialogues.cn: 你和家人住在一起吗？
dialogues.en: Do you live with your family?

dialogues.cn: 我住在学校宿舍。
dialogues.en: I live in the school dormitory.

dialogues.cn: 我叔叔住在上海。
dialogues.en: My uncle lives in Shanghai.

dialogues.cn: 我表妹今年刚上大学。
dialogues.en: My cousin just started college this year.

dialogues.cn: 我父母住在老家。
dialogues.en: My parents live in our hometown.

dialogues.cn: 你们多久见一次面？
dialogues.en: How often do you see each other?

dialogues.cn: 我最好的朋友性格很开朗。
dialogues.en: My best friend has a very outgoing personality.

dialogues.cn: 我们每周末一起打篮球。
dialogues.en: We play basketball together every weekend.

dialogues.cn: 我的邻居人很好。
dialogues.en: My neighbor is very kind.

dialogues.cn: 他像我的亲兄弟一样。
dialogues.en: He is like a brother to me.

dialogues.cn: 这个多少钱？
dialogues.en: How much is this?

dialogues.cn: 太贵了，能便宜一点吗？
dialogues.en: It's too expensive. Can you make it cheaper?

dialogues.cn: 我想买一件衬衫。
dialogues.en: I'd like to buy a shirt.

dialogues.cn: 有小一号的吗？
dialogues.en: Do you have a smaller size?

dialogues.cn: 我可以试穿吗？
dialogues.en: Can I try it on?

dialogues.cn: 这件衣服是什么颜色的？
dialogues.en: What color is this clothing?

dialogues.cn: 我想退货。
dialogues.en: I want to return this item.

dialogues.cn: 请问收银台在哪里？
dialogues.en: Excuse me, where is the cashier?

dialogues.cn: 你可以用现金或信用卡支付。
dialogues.en: You can pay by cash or credit card.

dialogues.cn: 今天有打折活动吗？
dialogues.en: Are there any discounts today?

dialogues.cn: 这个质量怎么样？
dialogues.en: How is the quality of this?

dialogues.cn: 我在找一双运动鞋。
dialogues.en: I'm looking for a pair of sports shoes.

dialogues.cn: 这款有别的颜色吗？
dialogues.en: Does this style come in other colors?

dialogues.cn: 我只看看，谢谢。
dialogues.en: I'm just looking, thank you.

dialogues.cn: 能给我一张收据吗？
dialogues.en: Can you give me a receipt?

dialogues.cn: 这个商品可以退换吗？
dialogues.en: Can this product be returned or exchanged?

dialogues.cn: 一共是一百五十块。
dialogues.en: That comes to one hundred and fifty yuan.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得哪个更好？
dialogues.en: Which one do you think is better?

dialogues.cn: 这件衣服很适合你。
dialogues.en: This outfit suits you very well.

dialogues.cn: 超市几点开门？
dialogues.en: What time does the supermarket open?

dialogues.cn: 请问，去火车站怎么走？
dialogues.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

dialogues.cn: 最近的地铁站在哪里？
dialogues.en: Where is the nearest subway station?

dialogues.cn: 请直走，然后左转。
dialogues.en: Please go straight, then turn left.

dialogues.cn: 走路大概要多久？
dialogues.en: How long does it take to walk?

dialogues.cn: 你可以坐公交车去。
dialogues.en: You can take a bus to get there.

dialogues.cn: 请问这趟车去市中心吗？
dialogues.en: Excuse me, does this bus go to the city center?

dialogues.cn: 我迷路了，能帮我一下吗？
dialogues.en: I'm lost. Can you help me?

dialogues.cn: 到那里大概需要二十分钟。
dialogues.en: It takes about twenty minutes to get there.

dialogues.cn: 在哪里可以打到出租车？
dialogues.en: Where can I catch a taxi?

dialogues.cn: 请带我去这个地址。
dialogues.en: Please take me to this address.

dialogues.cn: 这附近有停车场吗？
dialogues.en: Is there a parking lot nearby?

dialogues.cn: 你应该在下一站下车。
dialogues.en: You should get off at the next stop.

dialogues.cn: 我要一张去机场的票。
dialogues.en: I'd like a ticket to the airport.

dialogues.cn: 最后一班车几点？
dialogues.en: What time is the last bus?

dialogues.cn: 这里离市中心远吗？
dialogues.en: Is it far from the city center?

dialogues.cn: 过两个红绿灯就到了。
dialogues.en: You'll be there after two traffic lights.

dialogues.cn: 骑自行车大约十五分钟。
dialogues.en: It's about fifteen minutes by bicycle.

dialogues.cn: 这条路通向哪里？
dialogues.en: Where does this road lead to?

dialogues.cn: 需要换乘吗？
dialogues.en: Do I need to transfer?

dialogues.cn: 我应该走哪条路？
dialogues.en: Which way should I go?

dialogues.cn: 我饿了，我们去吃饭吧。
dialogues.en: I'm hungry. Let's go get something to eat.

dialogues.cn: 请给我菜单。
dialogues.en: Please give me the menu.

dialogues.cn: 你想吃什么？
dialogues.en: What would you like to eat?

dialogues.cn: 我想要一杯水。
dialogues.en: I'd like a glass of water.

dialogues.cn: 这个菜辣吗？
dialogues.en: Is this dish spicy?

dialogues.cn: 我不吃辣的。
dialogues.en: I don't eat spicy food.

dialogues.cn: 请买单。
dialogues.en: The bill, please.

dialogues.cn: 我吃不下了。
dialogues.en: I can't eat anymore.

dialogues.cn: 这道菜非常好吃。
dialogues.en: This dish is very delicious.

dialogues.cn: 你推荐什么菜？
dialogues.en: What dish do you recommend?

dialogues.cn: 我对花生过敏。
dialogues.en: I'm allergic to peanuts.

dialogues.cn: 请不要放太多盐。
dialogues.en: Please don't add too much salt.

dialogues.cn: 我的菜还没上。
dialogues.en: My dish hasn't been served yet.

dialogues.cn: 可以再给我一碗米饭吗？
dialogues.en: Can I have another bowl of rice?

dialogues.cn: 这里的特色菜是什么？
dialogues.en: What is the specialty here?

dialogues.cn: 我要一杯咖啡，不加糖。
dialogues.en: I'd like a coffee without sugar.

dialogues.cn: 可以打包吗？
dialogues.en: Can I get this to go?

dialogues.cn: 我最喜欢吃中国菜。
dialogues.en: I like Chinese food the most.

dialogues.cn: 早餐你通常吃什么？
dialogues.en: What do you usually have for breakfast?

dialogues.cn: 这家餐厅的环境很好。
dialogues.en: This restaurant has a nice atmosphere.

dialogues.cn: 今天天气怎么样？
dialogues.en: How is the weather today?

dialogues.cn: 今天天气很好。
dialogues.en: The weather is very nice today.

dialogues.cn: 外面下雨了。
dialogues.en: It's raining outside.

dialogues.cn: 明天会降温。
dialogues.en: It will be colder tomorrow.

dialogues.cn: 今天气温是多少度？
dialogues.en: What is the temperature today?

dialogues.cn: 今天大概三十度。
dialogues.en: It's about thirty degrees today.

dialogues.cn: 别忘了带伞。
dialogues.en: Don't forget to bring an umbrella.

dialogues.cn: 春天来了，天气变暖了。
dialogues.en: Spring is here. The weather is getting warmer.

dialogues.cn: 夏天这里很热。
dialogues.en: It is very hot here in summer.

dialogues.cn: 冬天会下雪吗？
dialogues.en: Does it snow in winter?

dialogues.cn: 外面刮大风。
dialogues.en: It's very windy outside.

dialogues.cn: 今天空气不太好。
dialogues.en: The air quality is not very good today.

dialogues.cn: 天气预报说明天晴天。
dialogues.en: The weather forecast says it will be sunny tomorrow.

dialogues.cn: 秋天是我最喜欢的季节。
dialogues.en: Autumn is my favorite season.

dialogues.cn: 今天湿度很大。
dialogues.en: The humidity is very high today.

dialogues.cn: 你家乡的气候怎么样？
dialogues.en: How is the climate in your hometown?

dialogues.cn: 我家乡四季分明。
dialogues.en: My hometown has four distinct seasons.

dialogues.cn: 下雨天我哪儿都不想去。
dialogues.en: I don't want to go anywhere on rainy days.

dialogues.cn: 快下暴雨了，我们回去吧。
dialogues.en: A storm is coming. Let's go back.

dialogues.cn: 这种天气很适合出去散步。
dialogues.en: This weather is perfect for a walk outside.

dialogues.cn: 现在几点了？
dialogues.en: What time is it now?

dialogues.cn: 现在三点半。
dialogues.en: It's half past three.

dialogues.cn: 我们几点见面？
dialogues.en: What time shall we meet?

dialogues.cn: 今天是星期几？
dialogues.en: What day is it today?

dialogues.cn: 今天是星期一。
dialogues.en: Today is Monday.

dialogues.cn: 你的生日是什么时候？
dialogues.en: When is your birthday?

dialogues.cn: 我的生日是三月十号。
dialogues.en: My birthday is March 10th.

dialogues.cn: 你什么时候有空？
dialogues.en: When are you free?

dialogues.cn: 请不要迟到。
dialogues.en: Please don't be late.

dialogues.cn: 我们约在下午两点可以吗？
dialogues.en: Shall we meet at two in the afternoon?

dialogues.cn: 今天几月几号？
dialogues.en: What is the date today?

dialogues.cn: 明天是周末了。
dialogues.en: Tomorrow is the weekend.

dialogues.cn: 这个月月底我要出差。
dialogues.en: I have a business trip at the end of this month.

dialogues.cn: 上课要迟到了。
dialogues.en: I'm going to be late for class.

dialogues.cn: 商店晚上九点关门。
dialogues.en: The store closes at nine in the evening.

dialogues.cn: 你每天几点起床？
dialogues.en: What time do you get up every day?

dialogues.cn: 我通常早上七点起床。
dialogues.en: I usually get up at seven in the morning.

dialogues.cn: 今天是我来这里的第三天。
dialogues.en: Today is my third day here.

dialogues.cn: 这个活动持续多长时间？
dialogues.en: How long does this event last?

dialogues.cn: 你的假期是什么时候？
dialogues.en: When is your holiday?

topics.topic: 打电话与网络 Phone & Internet

dialogues.cn: 喂，你好，请问是李先生吗？
dialogues.en: Hello, may I speak to Mr. Li?

dialogues.cn: 请稍等，我帮你转接。
dialogues.en: Please hold on. I'll transfer your call.

dialogues.cn: 你能再说一遍吗？
dialogues.en: Can you say that again?

dialogues.cn: 信号不太好，我听不清。
dialogues.en: The signal is poor. I can't hear you clearly.

dialogues.cn: 可以给我你的电话号码吗？
dialogues.en: Can you give me your phone number?

dialogues.cn: 请给我回电话。
dialogues.en: Please call me back.

dialogues.cn: 这里有没有无线网络？
dialogues.en: Is there Wi-Fi here?

dialogues.cn: 无线网络密码是什么？
dialogues.en: What is the Wi-Fi password?

dialogues.cn: 我的手机没电了。
dialogues.en: My phone is out of battery.

dialogues.cn: 你能发短信告诉我吗？
dialogues.en: Can you send me a text message?

dialogues.cn: 我的网络很慢。
dialogues.en: My internet is very slow.

dialogues.cn: 你有微信吗？
dialogues.en: Do you have WeChat?

dialogues.cn: 我给你发邮件了，你收到了吗？
dialogues.en: I sent you an email. Did you receive it?

dialogues.cn: 我打不通你的电话。
dialogues.en: I couldn't get through to your phone.

dialogues.cn: 我把地址发到你手机上。
dialogues.en: I'll send the address to your phone.

dialogues.cn: 你用什么社交软件？
dialogues.en: What social media apps do you use?

dialogues.cn: 我手机快没流量了。
dialogues.en: I'm running out of mobile data.

dialogues.cn: 你可以视频通话吗？
dialogues.en: Can you make a video call?

dialogues.cn: 抱歉让你久等了。
dialogues.en: Sorry to keep you waiting.

dialogues.cn: 我们保持联系。
dialogues.en: Let's keep in touch.

dialogues.cn: 你是学生吗？
dialogues.en: Are you a student?

dialogues.cn: 你学什么专业？
dialogues.en: What is your major?

dialogues.cn: 我在学英语。
dialogues.en: I'm learning English.

dialogues.cn: 学英语难吗？
dialogues.en: Is it difficult to learn English?

dialogues.cn: 我每天都练习口语。
dialogues.en: I practice speaking every day.

dialogues.cn: 你在哪里上的大学？
dialogues.en: Which university did you attend?

dialogues.cn: 我喜欢这门课。
dialogues.en: I like this course.

dialogues.cn: 老师讲得太快了。
dialogues.en: The teacher speaks too fast.

dialogues.cn: 作业什么时候交？
dialogues.en: When is the homework due?

dialogues.cn: 考试难不难？
dialogues.en: Is the exam difficult?

dialogues.cn: 我需要一本词典。
dialogues.en: I need a dictionary.

dialogues.cn: 图书馆几点关门？
dialogues.en: What time does the library close?

dialogues.cn: 我不太理解这个词的意思。
dialogues.en: I don't quite understand the meaning of this word.

dialogues.cn: 你能解释一下吗？
dialogues.en: Can you explain it?

dialogues.cn: 你毕业后打算做什么？
dialogues.en: What do you plan to do after graduation?

dialogues.cn: 我想出国留学。
dialogues.en: I want to study abroad.

dialogues.cn: 雅思考试对我来说有点难。
dialogues.en: The IELTS exam is a bit difficult for me.

dialogues.cn: 我正在准备期末考试。
dialogues.en: I'm preparing for the final exam.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么记单词？
dialogues.en: How do you memorize vocabulary?

dialogues.cn: 多读多写是学好语言的关键。
dialogues.en: Reading and writing more is the key to learning a language well.

dialogues.cn: 我不太舒服。
dialogues.en: I don't feel very well.

dialogues.cn: 我头疼。
dialogues.en: I have a headache.

dialogues.cn: 我感冒了。
dialogues.en: I have a cold.

dialogues.cn: 你需要去看医生。
dialogues.en: You need to see a doctor.

dialogues.cn: 最近的医院在哪里？
dialogues.en: Where is the nearest hospital?

dialogues.cn: 我发烧了。
dialogues.en: I have a fever.

dialogues.cn: 吃药了吗？
dialogues.en: Have you taken any medicine?

dialogues.cn: 你应该多休息。
dialogues.en: You should rest more.

dialogues.cn: 我的胃不舒服。
dialogues.en: My stomach feels uncomfortable.

dialogues.cn: 我牙疼，需要去看牙医。
dialogues.en: I have a toothache and need to see a dentist.

dialogues.cn: 每天锻炼对身体好。
dialogues.en: Exercising every day is good for your health.

dialogues.cn: 我每周去健身房两次。
dialogues.en: I go to the gym twice a week.

dialogues.cn: 你有什么症状？
dialogues.en: What symptoms do you have?

dialogues.cn: 我对这种药过敏。
dialogues.en: I'm allergic to this medicine.

dialogues.cn: 你需要多喝水。
dialogues.en: You need to drink more water.

dialogues.cn: 你的身体怎么样？
dialogues.en: How is your health?

dialogues.cn: 早睡早起对身体有好处。
dialogues.en: Going to bed early and rising early is good for your health.

dialogues.cn: 我需要买一些感冒药。
dialogues.en: I need to buy some cold medicine.

dialogues.cn: 体检结果一切正常。
dialogues.en: The physical exam results are all normal.

dialogues.cn: 保持好心情很重要。
dialogues.en: Maintaining a good mood is very important.

dialogues.cn: 我每天早上六点半起床。
dialogues.en: I get up at six thirty every morning.

dialogues.cn: 你平时怎么去上班？
dialogues.en: How do you usually go to work?

dialogues.cn: 我通常坐地铁上班，大概需要四十分钟。
dialogues.en: I usually take the subway to work. It takes about forty minutes.

dialogues.cn: 下班后我喜欢在家看电视放松。
dialogues.en: After work, I like to relax by watching TV at home.

dialogues.cn: 你周末通常做什么？
dialogues.en: What do you usually do on weekends?

dialogues.cn: 我经常在周末去超市买一周的食物。
dialogues.en: I often go to the supermarket on weekends to buy a week's worth of groceries.

dialogues.cn: 我每天都做家务，比如洗衣服和打扫卫生。
dialogues.en: I do housework every day, such as laundry and cleaning.

dialogues.cn: 你几点睡觉？
dialogues.en: What time do you go to bed?

dialogues.cn: 我尽量在晚上十一点之前睡觉。
dialogues.en: I try to go to bed before eleven at night.

dialogues.cn: 我觉得养成好的生活习惯很重要。
dialogues.en: I think it's important to develop good living habits.

dialogues.cn: 你每天花多长时间在上下班路上？
dialogues.en: How much time do you spend commuting every day?

dialogues.cn: 我的工作时间比较灵活。
dialogues.en: My work hours are quite flexible.

dialogues.cn: 我喜欢在早上洗澡。
dialogues.en: I like to take a shower in the morning.

dialogues.cn: 你经常做饭吗？
dialogues.en: Do you often cook?

dialogues.cn: 我一般自己做午饭带到公司去。
dialogues.en: I usually make my own lunch and bring it to the office.

dialogues.cn: 下了班以后我会去公园跑步。
dialogues.en: After work, I go jogging in the park.

dialogues.cn: 你有没有每天都坚持的习惯？
dialogues.en: Do you have any habits that you stick to every day?

dialogues.cn: 我每天都会花半小时读书。
dialogues.en: I spend half an hour reading every day.

dialogues.cn: 我觉得有规律的生活让人更健康。
dialogues.en: I think a regular lifestyle makes people healthier.

dialogues.cn: 你的工作是做什么的？
dialogues.en: What do you do for work?

dialogues.cn: 你有什么爱好？
dialogues.en: What hobbies do you have?

dialogues.cn: 我喜欢摄影，特别是拍风景照。
dialogues.en: I like photography, especially taking landscape photos.

dialogues.cn: 我从小就喜欢画画。
dialogues.en: I have liked drawing since I was a child.

dialogues.cn: 你平时看什么类型的电影？
dialogues.en: What type of movies do you usually watch?

dialogues.cn: 我比较喜欢看喜剧和科幻电影。
dialogues.en: I prefer watching comedies and science fiction movies.

dialogues.cn: 你最喜欢哪位歌手？
dialogues.en: Who is your favorite singer?

dialogues.cn: 我最近在学吉他，已经会弹几首歌了。
dialogues.en: I've been learning guitar recently and can already play a few songs.

dialogues.cn: 周末我喜欢和朋友一起踢足球。
dialogues.en: On weekends, I like playing soccer with friends.

dialogues.cn: 你每周运动几次？
dialogues.en: How many times do you exercise per week?

dialogues.cn: 我喜欢在安静的地方看书。
dialogues.en: I like reading in a quiet place.

dialogues.cn: 你对什么感兴趣？
dialogues.en: What are you interested in?

dialogues.cn: 我对历史很感兴趣。
dialogues.en: I'm very interested in history.

dialogues.cn: 游泳是我最喜欢的运动之一。
dialogues.en: Swimming is one of my favorite sports.

dialogues.cn: 你一般在什么时候做运动？
dialogues.en: When do you usually exercise?

dialogues.cn: 我觉得培养兴趣爱好可以丰富生活。
dialogues.en: I think developing hobbies can enrich your life.

dialogues.cn: 做饭对我来说是一种放松的方式。
dialogues.en: Cooking is a way for me to relax.

dialogues.cn: 你喜欢旅行吗？
dialogues.en: Do you like traveling?

dialogues.cn: 我小时候学过钢琴。
dialogues.en: I learned piano when I was a child.

dialogues.cn: 你最喜欢的书是哪一本？
dialogues.en: What is your favorite book?

dialogues.cn: 我最近迷上了烘焙。
dialogues.en: I've been really into baking recently.

dialogues.cn: 你在哪个公司工作？
dialogues.en: Which company do you work for?

dialogues.cn: 我在一家互联网公司做软件开发。
dialogues.en: I work as a software developer at an internet company.

dialogues.cn: 你的工作内容是什么？
dialogues.en: What does your job involve?

dialogues.cn: 我主要负责客户沟通和项目管理。
dialogues.en: I'm mainly responsible for client communication and project management.

dialogues.cn: 你喜欢你的工作吗？
dialogues.en: Do you like your job?

dialogues.cn: 我觉得我的工作很有挑战性，但也很有成就感。
dialogues.en: I find my job challenging but also very rewarding.

dialogues.cn: 你工作几年了？
dialogues.en: How many years have you been working?

dialogues.cn: 我已经工作五年了。
dialogues.en: I've been working for five years.

dialogues.cn: 你们公司的氛围怎么样？
dialogues.en: How is the atmosphere at your company?

dialogues.cn: 我们公司的同事都很友善。
dialogues.en: The colleagues at my company are all very friendly.

dialogues.cn: 你将来想做什么工作？
dialogues.en: What kind of job do you want in the future?

dialogues.cn: 我希望以后能自己开一家小店。
dialogues.en: I hope to open my own small shop in the future.

dialogues.cn: 你每天加班吗？
dialogues.en: Do you work overtime every day?

dialogues.cn: 我的工作压力有时候挺大的。
dialogues.en: My work can be quite stressful at times.

dialogues.cn: 你在工作中遇到过什么困难？
dialogues.en: What difficulties have you encountered at work?

dialogues.cn: 与不同性格的同事合作有时比较困难。
dialogues.en: Working with colleagues of different personalities can be difficult sometimes.

dialogues.cn: 你理想的工作是什么样的？
dialogues.en: What does your ideal job look like?

dialogues.cn: 你觉得工作经验重要还是学历重要？
dialogues.en: Do you think work experience or education is more important?

dialogues.cn: 我觉得两者都很重要。
dialogues.en: I think both are very important.

dialogues.cn: 今年的就业市场竞争很激烈。
dialogues.en: The job market is very competitive this year.

dialogues.cn: 你现在住在哪里？
dialogues.en: Where do you live now?

dialogues.cn: 我住在市中心的一间公寓里。
dialogues.en: I live in an apartment in the city center.

dialogues.cn: 你的房子是租的还是买的？
dialogues.en: Is your house rented or bought?

dialogues.cn: 我和朋友合租了一套两室一厅的房子。
dialogues.en: I share a two-bedroom apartment with a friend.

dialogues.cn: 你的房子怎么样？
dialogues.en: How is your house?

dialogues.cn: 我的房子虽然不大，但很温馨。
dialogues.en: My house is not big, but it's cozy.

dialogues.cn: 你的房子附近交通方便吗？
dialogues.en: Is the transportation near your house convenient?

dialogues.cn: 小区周围有超市和学校。
dialogues.en: There are supermarkets and schools around the neighborhood.

dialogues.cn: 你每个月房租多少钱？
dialogues.en: How much is your monthly rent?

dialogues.cn: 你更喜欢住城市还是农村？
dialogues.en: Do you prefer living in the city or the countryside?

dialogues.cn: 你对你的房子满意吗？
dialogues.en: Are you satisfied with your house?

dialogues.cn: 你以后想住什么样的房子？
dialogues.en: What kind of house would you like to live in the future?

dialogues.cn: 我希望将来能买一套大房子。
dialogues.en: I hope to buy a big house in the future.

dialogues.cn: 你喜欢什么风格的装修？
dialogues.en: What style of decoration do you like?

dialogues.cn: 我觉得简约风格比较舒适。
dialogues.en: I think a minimalist style is more comfortable.

dialogues.cn: 买房在中国是一件大事。
dialogues.en: Buying a house in China is a big deal.

dialogues.cn: 这个小区的环境很好。
dialogues.en: The environment of this neighborhood is very nice.

dialogues.cn: 你们家有阳台吗？
dialogues.en: Does your home have a balcony?

dialogues.cn: 我的房间朝南，采光很好。
dialogues.en: My room faces south and gets great natural light.

dialogues.cn: 搬家是一件很累的事。
dialogues.en: Moving is a very tiring thing.

dialogues.cn: 春节是中国最重要的节日。
dialogues.en: The Spring Festival is the most important festival in China.

dialogues.cn: 你今年春节怎么过的？
dialogues.en: How did you celebrate the Spring Festival this year?

dialogues.cn: 春节的时候我们一家人团聚在一起。
dialogues.en: During the Spring Festival, our family gathers together.

dialogues.cn: 过年的时候我们会吃饺子。
dialogues.en: We eat dumplings during the New Year.

dialogues.cn: 你最喜欢哪个节日？
dialogues.en: Which festival do you like the most?

dialogues.cn: 中秋节我们会吃月饼、赏月亮。
dialogues.en: During the Mid-Autumn Festival, we eat mooncakes and admire the moon.

dialogues.cn: 你的生日一般怎么庆祝？
dialogues.en: How do you usually celebrate your birthday?

dialogues.cn: 过生日的时候朋友会送我礼物。
dialogues.en: Friends give me gifts on my birthday.

dialogues.cn: 你收到过什么特别的礼物吗？
dialogues.en: Have you ever received any special gifts?

dialogues.cn: 在中国，红色代表好运和幸福。
dialogues.en: In China, red represents good luck and happiness.

dialogues.cn: 你过圣诞节吗？
dialogues.en: Do you celebrate Christmas?

dialogues.cn: 我最喜欢的节日活动是看烟花。
dialogues.en: My favorite festival activity is watching fireworks.

dialogues.cn: 端午节我们会吃粽子和赛龙舟。
dialogues.en: During the Dragon Boat Festival, we eat zongzi and watch dragon boat races.

dialogues.cn: 春节的时候大人会给小孩压岁钱。
dialogues.en: During the Spring Festival, adults give children lucky money.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得现在过年还有年味吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think the New Year still feels festive nowadays?

dialogues.cn: 节日是和家人朋友相聚的好时光。
dialogues.en: Festivals are a great time to reunite with family and friends.

dialogues.cn: 你去年国庆节去了哪里？
dialogues.en: Where did you go during the National Day holiday last year?

dialogues.cn: 清明节我们会去扫墓。
dialogues.en: During the Qingming Festival, we visit the graves of our ancestors.

dialogues.cn: 你更喜欢传统节日还是现代节日？
dialogues.en: Do you prefer traditional festivals or modern holidays?

dialogues.cn: 过节的时候街上很热闹。
dialogues.en: The streets are very lively during festivals.

dialogues.cn: 你喜欢在网上购物还是去实体店？
dialogues.en: Do you prefer shopping online or going to physical stores?

dialogues.cn: 网购虽然方便，但是看不到实物。
dialogues.en: Online shopping is convenient, but you can't see the actual product.

dialogues.cn: 我经常在淘宝上买东西。
dialogues.en: I often buy things on Taobao.

dialogues.cn: 你通常用什么方式付款？
dialogues.en: What payment method do you usually use?

dialogues.cn: 现在大部分人都用手机支付。
dialogues.en: Most people use mobile payment now.

dialogues.cn: 你买过最贵的东西是什么？
dialogues.en: What is the most expensive thing you have bought?

dialogues.cn: 买东西之前我会先比较价格。
dialogues.en: I compare prices before buying things.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得大品牌的东西质量一定好吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think products from big brands are always good quality?

dialogues.cn: 有时候打折促销并不一定真的便宜。
dialogues.en: Sometimes sale promotions aren't really cheaper.

dialogues.cn: 你一般多久买一次衣服？
dialogues.en: How often do you buy clothes?

dialogues.cn: 我花钱比较节省，不会乱买东西。
dialogues.en: I'm quite frugal and don't buy things recklessly.

dialogues.cn: 你有没有攒钱的习惯？
dialogues.en: Do you have a habit of saving money?

dialogues.cn: 双十一的时候我买了很多东西。
dialogues.en: I bought a lot of things during Double Eleven.

dialogues.cn: 我觉得量入为出是很好的消费观念。
dialogues.en: I think living within your means is a good spending philosophy.

dialogues.cn: 退货的时候需要提供收据。
dialogues.en: You need to provide a receipt when returning items.

dialogues.cn: 你更喜欢现金支付还是电子支付？
dialogues.en: Do you prefer cash or electronic payment?

dialogues.cn: 这件衣服正在打五折。
dialogues.en: This clothing item is fifty percent off.

dialogues.cn: 你对理财有什么了解？
dialogues.en: What do you know about financial management?

dialogues.cn: 我觉得年轻人应该学会理财。
dialogues.en: I think young people should learn how to manage their finances.

dialogues.cn: 每个月我都会存一些钱。
dialogues.en: I save some money every month.

dialogues.cn: 你去过哪些地方旅行？
dialogues.en: What places have you traveled to?

dialogues.cn: 我去年去了西安，参观了兵马俑。
dialogues.en: I went to Xi'an last year and visited the Terracotta Warriors.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得旅行最吸引你的是什么？
dialogues.en: What attracts you most about traveling?

dialogues.cn: 我喜欢通过旅行了解不同的文化。
dialogues.en: I like learning about different cultures through traveling.

dialogues.cn: 你出国旅行过吗？
dialogues.en: Have you ever traveled abroad?

dialogues.cn: 出去旅行你一般住哪里？
dialogues.en: Where do you usually stay when traveling?

dialogues.cn: 我比较喜欢住民宿，可以体验当地生活。
dialogues.en: I prefer staying at homestays to experience local life.

dialogues.cn: 旅行之前你会做攻略吗？
dialogues.en: Do you make a travel plan before a trip?

dialogues.cn: 你喜欢跟团游还是自由行？
dialogues.en: Do you prefer group tours or independent travel?

dialogues.cn: 我觉得自由行更自由，可以按自己的节奏走。
dialogues.en: I think independent travel gives you more freedom to go at your own pace.

dialogues.cn: 旅行中你遇到过什么困难吗？
dialogues.en: Have you encountered any difficulties while traveling?

dialogues.cn: 语言不通有时候会造成麻烦。
dialogues.en: Language barriers can sometimes cause trouble.

dialogues.cn: 去过的城市中你最喜欢哪一个？
dialogues.en: Which city that you've visited do you like the most?

dialogues.cn: 云南的风景特别美。
dialogues.en: The scenery in Yunnan is especially beautiful.

dialogues.cn: 我觉得旅行可以开阔眼界。
dialogues.en: I think traveling can broaden your horizons.

dialogues.cn: 你下一次旅行打算去哪里？
dialogues.en: Where do you plan to go on your next trip?

dialogues.cn: 旅行的时候我喜欢拍照留念。
dialogues.en: I like to take photos when traveling as souvenirs.

dialogues.cn: 你更喜欢自然风光还是人文景观？
dialogues.en: Do you prefer natural scenery or cultural attractions?

dialogues.cn: 这个景点在旅游旺季人特别多。
dialogues.en: This scenic spot is very crowded during peak tourist season.

dialogues.cn: 旅行最让我开心的是能吃到各地美食。
dialogues.en: What makes me happiest about traveling is trying food from different places.

dialogues.cn: 你对未来有什么打算？
dialogues.en: What are your plans for the future?

dialogues.cn: 我希望将来能找到一份好工作。
dialogues.en: I hope to find a good job in the future.

dialogues.cn: 我计划明年去英国读研究生。
dialogues.en: I plan to go to the UK next year for a master's degree.

dialogues.cn: 你有没有长远的目标？
dialogues.en: Do you have any long-term goals?

dialogues.cn: 我想在三十岁之前买房。
dialogues.en: I want to buy a house before I turn thirty.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得计划赶得上变化吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think plans can keep up with changes?

dialogues.cn: 有时候事情不会按计划发展。
dialogues.en: Sometimes things don't go as planned.

dialogues.cn: 我认为做好计划可以减少焦虑。
dialogues.en: I believe making good plans can reduce anxiety.

dialogues.cn: 你毕业后想留在大城市还是回老家？
dialogues.en: After graduation, do you want to stay in a big city or go back to your hometown?

dialogues.cn: 我想要一边工作一边旅行。
dialogues.en: I want to work while traveling at the same time.

dialogues.cn: 你有没有想过创业？
dialogues.en: Have you ever thought about starting your own business?

dialogues.cn: 我的短期目标是通过雅思考试。
dialogues.en: My short-term goal is to pass the IELTS exam.

dialogues.cn: 我希望五年后能在事业上有所成就。
dialogues.en: I hope to achieve something in my career within five years.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得什么最重要，事业还是家庭？
dialogues.en: What do you think is more important, career or family?

dialogues.cn: 我认为两者需要平衡。
dialogues.en: I think both need to be balanced.

dialogues.cn: 你以后想学什么新技能？
dialogues.en: What new skills do you want to learn in the future?

dialogues.cn: 我一直想学一门第二外语。
dialogues.en: I've always wanted to learn a second foreign language.

dialogues.cn: 如果有机会，我想去国外工作几年。
dialogues.en: If given the chance, I'd like to work abroad for a few years.

dialogues.cn: 未来的事情说不准，但我很期待。
dialogues.en: The future is uncertain, but I'm looking forward to it.

dialogues.cn: 人生规划是一个不断调整的过程。
dialogues.en: Life planning is a process of constant adjustment.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待中国的教育体制？
dialogues.en: What do you think about the education system in China?

dialogues.cn: 我认为高考对学生来说非常重要，但压力也很大。
dialogues.en: I think the college entrance exam is very important for students, but it also creates a lot of pressure.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得应试教育有什么优缺点？
dialogues.en: What do you think are the advantages and disadvantages of exam-oriented education?

dialogues.cn: 应试教育虽然能帮助学生掌握基础知识，但可能限制了创造力。
dialogues.en: Exam-oriented education helps students master basic knowledge, but it may limit creativity.

dialogues.cn: 你认为大学教育的价值是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the value of university education?

dialogues.cn: 大学不仅是学知识的地方，也是培养独立思考能力的地方。
dialogues.en: University is not only a place to gain knowledge but also a place to develop independent thinking skills.

dialogues.cn: 现在很多学生选择出国留学，你怎么看？
dialogues.en: Many students choose to study abroad now. What's your opinion?

dialogues.cn: 出国留学可以开阔视野，但也面临文化适应的挑战。
dialogues.en: Studying abroad can broaden your horizons, but it also comes with the challenge of cultural adaptation.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得在线教育能取代传统课堂吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think online education can replace traditional classrooms?

dialogues.cn: 在线教育更加灵活，但缺少面对面的互动。
dialogues.en: Online education is more flexible, but it lacks face-to-face interaction.

dialogues.cn: 你认为老师在教育中最重要的作用是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the most important role of teachers in education?

dialogues.cn: 好老师不仅传授知识，还应该激发学生的学习兴趣。
dialogues.en: A good teacher not only imparts knowledge but should also inspire students' interest in learning.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得学校应该更重视体育课吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think schools should place more emphasis on physical education?

dialogues.cn: 你认为成绩能代表一个人的能力吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think grades can represent a person's ability?

dialogues.cn: 成绩只是评价一个人的其中一个方面。
dialogues.en: Grades are only one aspect of evaluating a person.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得教育公平吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think education is fair?

dialogues.cn: 城乡之间的教育资源差距仍然存在。
dialogues.en: The gap in educational resources between urban and rural areas still exists.

dialogues.cn: 你认为学校应该教学生哪些实用技能？
dialogues.en: What practical skills do you think schools should teach students?

dialogues.cn: 我认为理财和沟通技巧应该纳入课程。
dialogues.en: I think financial management and communication skills should be included in the curriculum.

dialogues.cn: 终身学习的观念越来越被重视。
dialogues.en: The concept of lifelong learning is receiving increasing attention.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得现在环境问题严重吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think environmental problems are serious now?

dialogues.cn: 空气污染是我们城市面临的一个大问题。
dialogues.en: Air pollution is a big problem facing our city.

dialogues.cn: 你平时会做哪些环保的事情？
dialogues.en: What environmentally friendly things do you usually do?

dialogues.cn: 我会尽量少用塑料袋，自备购物袋。
dialogues.en: I try to use fewer plastic bags and bring my own shopping bags.

dialogues.cn: 垃圾分类对保护环境非常重要。
dialogues.en: Garbage sorting is very important for protecting the environment.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得政府应该采取什么措施来保护环境？
dialogues.en: What measures do you think the government should take to protect the environment?

dialogues.cn: 我认为应该加大对污染企业的处罚力度。
dialogues.en: I think penalties for polluting companies should be increased.

dialogues.cn: 你对全球变暖有什么看法？
dialogues.en: What are your views on global warming?

dialogues.cn: 全球变暖导致极端天气越来越频繁。
dialogues.en: Global warming is causing extreme weather to become more frequent.

dialogues.cn: 新能源汽车是未来的发展趋势。
dialogues.en: New energy vehicles are the future development trend.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得个人能为环保做出多大贡献？
dialogues.en: How much do you think individuals can contribute to environmental protection?

dialogues.cn: 节约用水和用电是每个人都能做到的。
dialogues.en: Saving water and electricity is something everyone can do.

dialogues.cn: 你们城市有公共自行车吗？
dialogues.en: Does your city have public bicycles?

dialogues.cn: 骑自行车既环保又健康。
dialogues.en: Riding a bicycle is both environmentally friendly and healthy.

dialogues.cn: 你支持使用可再生能源吗？
dialogues.en: Do you support the use of renewable energy?

dialogues.cn: 太阳能和风能是很好的替代能源。
dialogues.en: Solar energy and wind energy are good alternative energy sources.

dialogues.cn: 很多人提倡低碳生活，你怎么看？
dialogues.en: Many people advocate for a low-carbon lifestyle. What do you think?

dialogues.cn: 保护环境需要全社会的共同努力。
dialogues.en: Protecting the environment requires the joint effort of the whole society.

dialogues.cn: 一次性用品对环境造成了很大危害。
dialogues.en: Disposable products cause great harm to the environment.

dialogues.cn: 我觉得我们应该更加重视可持续发展。
dialogues.en: I think we should pay more attention to sustainable development.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得手机对你生活的影响大吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think your phone has a big impact on your life?

dialogues.cn: 手机已经成为我们生活中不可缺少的一部分。
dialogues.en: Mobile phones have become an indispensable part of our lives.

dialogues.cn: 你平时用手机做什么？
dialogues.en: What do you usually use your phone for?

dialogues.cn: 我主要用手机聊天、看新闻和听音乐。
dialogues.en: I mainly use my phone to chat, read news, and listen to music.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得社交媒体对人们有什么影响？
dialogues.en: What impact do you think social media has on people?

dialogues.cn: 社交媒体让人们联系更方便，但也容易让人沉迷。
dialogues.en: Social media makes it easier for people to stay connected, but it can also be addictive.

dialogues.cn: 你对人工智能怎么看？
dialogues.en: What do you think about artificial intelligence?

dialogues.cn: 人工智能会改变很多行业，但也会创造新的就业机会。
dialogues.en: AI will change many industries, but it will also create new job opportunities.

dialogues.cn: 你担心人工智能会取代人类的工作吗？
dialogues.en: Are you worried that AI will replace human jobs?

dialogues.cn: 有些重复性工作确实可能被取代，但创造性工作很难被替代。
dialogues.en: Some repetitive jobs may indeed be replaced, but creative work is hard to replace.

dialogues.cn: 你最常用的手机应用是什么？
dialogues.en: What is the most used app on your phone?

dialogues.cn: 你觉得网上购物有什么好处和坏处？
dialogues.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of online shopping?

dialogues.cn: 网上购物方便快捷，但商品质量有时难以保证。
dialogues.en: Online shopping is convenient and fast, but product quality can be hard to guarantee.

dialogues.cn: 你一天大概花多少时间在手机上？
dialogues.en: How much time do you spend on your phone each day?

dialogues.cn: 我觉得很多人都有手机依赖症。
dialogues.en: I think many people are addicted to their phones.

dialogues.cn: 你会定期清理手机里的应用吗？
dialogues.en: Do you regularly clean up the apps on your phone?

dialogues.cn: 你觉得纸质书和电子书哪个更好？
dialogues.en: Do you think paper books or e-books are better?

dialogues.cn: 我更喜欢纸质书，翻页的感觉很真实。
dialogues.en: I prefer paper books. The feeling of turning pages is more real.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得网络教育的前景如何？
dialogues.en: How do you see the future of online education?

dialogues.cn: 科技让我们的生活更便利，但也带来了一些问题。
dialogues.en: Technology makes our lives more convenient, but it also brings some problems.

dialogues.cn: 你平时通过什么渠道了解新闻？
dialogues.en: Through what channels do you usually get your news?

dialogues.cn: 我主要通过手机新闻应用和微信公众号获取新闻。
dialogues.en: I mainly get news through mobile news apps and WeChat official accounts.

dialogues.cn: 你更信任传统媒体还是新媒体？
dialogues.en: Do you trust traditional media or new media more?

dialogues.cn: 我认为传统媒体在报道深度上更有优势。
dialogues.en: I think traditional media has an advantage in in-depth reporting.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待网络上的假新闻？
dialogues.en: How do you view fake news on the internet?

dialogues.cn: 假新闻传播很快，我们应该学会辨别信息的真伪。
dialogues.en: Fake news spreads quickly. We should learn to distinguish between true and false information.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得电视新闻和网络新闻有什么区别？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the difference between TV news and online news?

dialogues.cn: 网络新闻更新更快，但信息不一定准确。
dialogues.en: Online news is updated faster, but the information is not always accurate.

dialogues.cn: 你一般关注哪类新闻？
dialogues.en: What type of news do you usually follow?

dialogues.cn: 我比较关注科技和教育类的新闻。
dialogues.en: I pay more attention to technology and education news.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得自媒体的发展对社会有什么影响？
dialogues.en: What impact do you think the development of self-media has on society?

dialogues.cn: 自媒体让每个人都有发声的机会，但也带来了信息泛滥的问题。
dialogues.en: Self-media gives everyone a chance to speak up, but it also brings the problem of information overload.

dialogues.cn: 你会在社交平台上分享新闻吗？
dialogues.en: Do you share news on social media platforms?

dialogues.cn: 你认为记者应该具备什么素质？
dialogues.en: What qualities do you think journalists should have?

dialogues.cn: 记者应该客观、真实、及时地报道新闻。
dialogues.en: Journalists should report news objectively, truthfully, and promptly.

dialogues.cn: 你对广告有什么看法？
dialogues.en: What are your views on advertising?

dialogues.cn: 有些广告很有创意，但过多的广告会让人感到厌烦。
dialogues.en: Some ads are very creative, but too many ads can be annoying.

dialogues.cn: 你认为广告对消费者的购买决策影响大吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think advertising has a big influence on consumers' purchasing decisions?

dialogues.cn: 现在的年轻人越来越倾向于从社交媒体获取信息。
dialogues.en: Nowadays, young people increasingly tend to get information from social media.

dialogues.cn: 辨别信息的真伪是现代人必备的技能。
dialogues.en: Being able to distinguish true from false information is an essential skill for modern people.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得中国传统文化中最有代表性的是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the most representative of traditional Chinese culture?

dialogues.cn: 我认为书法和京剧是中国传统文化的瑰宝。
dialogues.en: I think calligraphy and Peking Opera are treasures of traditional Chinese culture.

dialogues.cn: 你对中西方文化差异有什么感受？
dialogues.en: What are your feelings about the cultural differences between China and the West?

dialogues.cn: 中国人更注重集体主义，而西方人更注重个人主义。
dialogues.en: Chinese people value collectivism more, while Westerners value individualism more.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得传统文化在现代社会中还有价值吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think traditional culture still has value in modern society?

dialogues.cn: 传统文化是我们民族的根，应该得到传承和保护。
dialogues.en: Traditional culture is the root of our nation and should be passed down and protected.

dialogues.cn: 你知道哪些中国的传统手工艺？
dialogues.en: What traditional Chinese handicrafts do you know?

dialogues.cn: 剪纸、刺绣和陶瓷都是中国的传统手工艺。
dialogues.en: Paper cutting, embroidery, and ceramics are all traditional Chinese handicrafts.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得年轻人对中国传统文化感兴趣吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think young people are interested in traditional Chinese culture?

dialogues.cn: 最近几年传统文化在年轻人中越来越受欢迎。
dialogues.en: Traditional culture has become increasingly popular among young people in recent years.

dialogues.cn: 你有没有参加过什么传统文化活动？
dialogues.en: Have you participated in any traditional cultural activities?

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待外来文化的影响？
dialogues.en: How do you view the influence of foreign cultures?

dialogues.cn: 我们既要吸收外来文化的精华，也要保持自己的文化特色。
dialogues.en: We should absorb the essence of foreign cultures while maintaining our own cultural identity.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得语言和文化之间有什么关系？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the relationship between language and culture?

dialogues.cn: 语言是文化的载体，学习一门语言也是了解一种文化。
dialogues.en: Language is a vehicle for culture. Learning a language is also learning about a culture.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得全球化对文化多样性有什么影响？
dialogues.en: What impact do you think globalization has on cultural diversity?

dialogues.cn: 全球化在促进文化交流的同时，也威胁着一些小众文化的生存。
dialogues.en: While globalization promotes cultural exchange, it also threatens the survival of some minority cultures.

dialogues.cn: 你最喜欢中国哪个朝代的历史？
dialogues.en: Which dynasty in Chinese history do you like the most?

dialogues.cn: 我最感兴趣的是唐朝，因为那是中国文化最繁荣的时期之一。
dialogues.en: I'm most interested in the Tang Dynasty, as it was one of the most culturally prosperous periods in China.

dialogues.cn: 保护文化遗产是每个人的责任。
dialogues.en: Protecting cultural heritage is everyone's responsibility.

dialogues.cn: 你认为运动对健康有多重要？
dialogues.en: How important do you think exercise is for health?

dialogues.cn: 运动不仅能强身健体，还能缓解压力。
dialogues.en: Exercise not only strengthens the body but also helps relieve stress.

dialogues.cn: 你最喜欢的运动是什么？
dialogues.en: What is your favorite sport?

dialogues.cn: 我最喜欢打羽毛球，每周都会去打两次。
dialogues.en: I like playing badminton the most. I play twice a week.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得中国人为何越来越重视运动了？
dialogues.en: Why do you think Chinese people are paying more attention to exercise?

dialogues.cn: 随着生活水平的提高，人们对健康越来越关注。
dialogues.en: As living standards improve, people are becoming more health-conscious.

dialogues.cn: 你会关注自己的饮食健康吗？
dialogues.en: Do you pay attention to your diet?

dialogues.cn: 我尽量少吃油炸食品和高糖食物。
dialogues.en: I try to eat less fried food and high-sugar food.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得学校应该增加体育课的比重吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think schools should increase the proportion of physical education classes?

dialogues.cn: 中国的学生压力大，运动时间偏少。
dialogues.en: Chinese students are under a lot of pressure and have less time for exercise.

dialogues.cn: 你认为心理健康和身体健康一样重要吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think mental health is as important as physical health?

dialogues.cn: 很多人忽视了心理健康，其实它同样重要。
dialogues.en: Many people overlook mental health, but it is equally important.

dialogues.cn: 你有压力的时候会怎么放松？
dialogues.en: How do you relax when you're stressed?

dialogues.cn: 我通常会听音乐或者出去散步来减压。
dialogues.en: I usually listen to music or go for a walk to relieve stress.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待越来越多的人开始跑马拉松？
dialogues.en: How do you view the growing number of people participating in marathons?

dialogues.cn: 马拉松是一种挑战自我的运动方式，也代表着健康的生活理念。
dialogues.en: Marathon running is a way to challenge yourself and represents a healthy lifestyle philosophy.

dialogues.cn: 你一般什么时间锻炼？
dialogues.en: When do you usually exercise?

dialogues.cn: 我更喜欢在早晨跑步，因为早上空气好，精神也更好。
dialogues.en: I prefer running in the morning because the air is fresh and I feel more energized.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得什么样的饮食习惯最健康？
dialogues.en: What kind of eating habits do you think are the healthiest?

dialogues.cn: 均衡饮食，多吃蔬菜水果，少吃加工食品是最基本的健康饮食原则。
dialogues.en: A balanced diet with more fruits and vegetables and less processed food is the most basic healthy eating principle.

dialogues.cn: 你认为当今社会面临的最大问题是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the biggest problem facing society today?

dialogues.cn: 贫富差距不断加大是许多国家面临的重要社会问题。
dialogues.en: The widening gap between the rich and the poor is an important social issue facing many countries.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待城市化带来的问题？
dialogues.en: How do you view the problems caused by urbanization?

dialogues.cn: 城市化虽然促进了经济发展，但也带来了交通拥堵和环境污染等问题。
dialogues.en: While urbanization has promoted economic growth, it has also brought problems such as traffic congestion and environmental pollution.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得应该如何解决老龄化问题？
dialogues.en: How do you think we should address the aging population problem?

dialogues.cn: 完善养老保障体系和鼓励生育是应对老龄化的有效措施。
dialogues.en: Improving the pension system and encouraging childbirth are effective measures to address the aging population.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待年轻人就业难的问题？
dialogues.en: How do you view the difficulty of employment for young people?

dialogues.cn: 就业难既与经济形势有关，也和教育与市场需求的脱节有关。
dialogues.en: Employment difficulties are related to both the economic situation and the gap between education and market demands.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得房价过高会对社会产生什么影响？
dialogues.en: What impact do you think high housing prices have on society?

dialogues.cn: 高房价增加了年轻人的生活压力，也可能影响人口出生率。
dialogues.en: High housing prices increase the pressure on young people's lives and may also affect the birth rate.

dialogues.cn: 你认为志愿服务对社会有什么意义？
dialogues.en: What significance do you think volunteer work has for society?

dialogues.cn: 志愿服务不仅能帮助他人，还能增强社区凝聚力。
dialogues.en: Volunteer work not only helps others but also strengthens community cohesion.

dialogues.cn: 你认为政府在解决社会问题中应该扮演什么角色？
dialogues.en: What role do you think the government should play in solving social problems?

dialogues.cn: 政府应该在教育、医疗和住房等方面提供更多保障。
dialogues.en: The government should provide more support in areas such as education, healthcare, and housing.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待社会上的性别平等问题？
dialogues.en: How do you view gender equality in society?

dialogues.cn: 虽然社会在进步，但在某些行业仍然存在性别歧视现象。
dialogues.en: Although society is progressing, gender discrimination still exists in certain industries.

dialogues.cn: 你认为慈善捐款能真正解决贫困问题吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think charitable donations can truly solve poverty?

dialogues.cn: 慈善捐款能起到一定作用，但解决贫困需要系统性的政策支持。
dialogues.en: Charitable donations can play a role, but solving poverty requires systematic policy support.

dialogues.cn: 你对社会的未来持乐观态度吗？
dialogues.en: Are you optimistic about the future of society?

dialogues.cn: 总体上我持谨慎乐观的态度，相信社会会越来越好。
dialogues.en: Overall, I'm cautiously optimistic and believe society will continue to improve.

dialogues.cn: 你对目前的经济形势怎么看？
dialogues.en: What do you think about the current economic situation?

dialogues.cn: 虽然全球经济面临一些挑战，但中国经济仍有很强的韧性。
dialogues.en: Although the global economy faces some challenges, China's economy still shows strong resilience.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得通货膨胀对普通人的影响大吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think inflation has a big impact on ordinary people?

dialogues.cn: 通货膨胀会降低人们的购买力，尤其是对低收入群体的影响更大。
dialogues.en: Inflation reduces people's purchasing power, and it has a greater impact on low-income groups in particular.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待共享经济？
dialogues.en: How do you view the sharing economy?

dialogues.cn: 共享经济提高了资源的利用效率，但监管方面还需要加强。
dialogues.en: The sharing economy has improved the efficiency of resource utilization, but regulation still needs to be strengthened.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得直播带货是可持续的商业模式吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think live-streaming e-commerce is a sustainable business model?

dialogues.cn: 直播带货改变了传统的销售方式，但存在产品质量参差不齐的问题。
dialogues.en: Live-streaming e-commerce has changed traditional sales methods, but there are issues with inconsistent product quality.

dialogues.cn: 你对中国消费者观念的变化有什么观察？
dialogues.en: What observations do you have about changes in Chinese consumer attitudes?

dialogues.cn: 越来越多的消费者开始理性消费，不再盲目追求品牌。
dialogues.en: More and more consumers are starting to consume rationally, no longer blindly pursuing brands.

dialogues.cn: 你认为中国的中产阶级面临的最大压力是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the biggest pressure facing China's middle class?

dialogues.cn: 教育、医疗和住房成本是中产阶级面临的三大压力。
dialogues.en: Education, healthcare, and housing costs are the three major pressures facing the middle class.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待年轻人的超前消费现象？
dialogues.en: How do you view the phenomenon of young people's advance consumption?

dialogues.cn: 适度消费信贷可以刺激经济，但过度借贷会带来严重的财务风险。
dialogues.en: Moderate consumer credit can stimulate the economy, but excessive borrowing can bring serious financial risks.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得创业需要具备哪些素质？
dialogues.en: What qualities do you think are needed for entrepreneurship?

dialogues.cn: 创业者需要有创新精神、抗压能力和良好的执行力。
dialogues.en: Entrepreneurs need innovative thinking, resilience, and good execution skills.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待中国与世界的经济联系？
dialogues.en: How do you view the economic connection between China and the world?

dialogues.cn: 全球化使各国经济相互依存，合作才能实现共赢。
dialogues.en: Globalization makes economies interdependent, and cooperation is the key to achieving win-win outcomes.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得经济发展的最终目的是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the ultimate goal of economic development?

dialogues.cn: 经济发展的最终目的是提高人民的生活质量和幸福感。
dialogues.en: The ultimate goal of economic development is to improve people's quality of life and happiness.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得大城市和小城市的生活有什么不同？
dialogues.en: What do you think is different about living in a big city versus a small city?

dialogues.cn: 大城市机会多、资源丰富，但生活成本高、竞争激烈。
dialogues.en: Big cities have more opportunities and abundant resources, but the cost of living is high and competition is fierce.

dialogues.cn: 你更喜欢住在城市还是乡村？
dialogues.en: Do you prefer living in the city or the countryside?

dialogues.cn: 乡村生活节奏慢、空气好，但公共设施不够完善。
dialogues.en: Countryside life is slower-paced with cleaner air, but public facilities are not as developed.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待越来越多的人从农村搬到城市？
dialogues.en: How do you view the increasing number of people moving from rural areas to cities?

dialogues.cn: 城市化是社会发展的必然趋势，但也要关注农村的可持续发展。
dialogues.en: Urbanization is an inevitable trend of social development, but we should also focus on sustainable development in rural areas.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得乡村振兴最重要的是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is most important for rural revitalization?

dialogues.cn: 我认为基础设施建设和人才培养是乡村振兴的关键。
dialogues.en: I believe infrastructure construction and talent cultivation are the keys to rural revitalization.

dialogues.cn: 你对目前城市的交通状况满意吗？
dialogues.en: Are you satisfied with the current traffic situation in cities?

dialogues.cn: 交通拥堵是很多大城市的通病，公共交通的完善可以缓解这一问题。
dialogues.en: Traffic congestion is a common problem in many big cities, and improving public transportation can alleviate this issue.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得理想的城市应该是什么样的？
dialogues.en: What do you think an ideal city should be like?

dialogues.cn: 理想的城市应该有完善的公共服务、良好的环境和包容的文化氛围。
dialogues.en: An ideal city should have complete public services, a good environment, and an inclusive cultural atmosphere.

dialogues.cn: 你所在的城市有什么让你不满意的地方吗？
dialogues.en: Are there any aspects of your city that you're not satisfied with?

dialogues.cn: 我所在的城市冬天雾霾比较严重，空气质量有待改善。
dialogues.en: My city has relatively serious smog in winter, and the air quality needs to be improved.

dialogues.cn: 你认为智慧城市的概念怎么样？
dialogues.en: What do you think of the concept of smart cities?

dialogues.cn: 智慧城市可以利用科技手段提高城市管理效率和居民生活质量。
dialogues.en: Smart cities can use technology to improve urban management efficiency and residents' quality of life.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得城市的绿化重不重要？
dialogues.en: Do you think urban greening is important?

dialogues.cn: 城市绿化不仅能美化环境，还能改善空气质量和居民的心理健康。
dialogues.en: Urban greening not only beautifies the environment but also improves air quality and residents' mental health.

dialogues.cn: 你有没有想过搬到另一个城市生活？
dialogues.en: Have you ever thought about moving to another city?

dialogues.cn: 我曾经考虑过去成都生活，因为那里生活节奏适中，美食也很多。
dialogues.en: I once considered moving to Chengdu because the pace of life there is moderate and there's plenty of good food.

dialogues.cn: 你认为在职场中最重要的能力是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the most important ability in the workplace?

dialogues.cn: 我认为沟通能力和团队协作能力在职场中至关重要。
dialogues.en: I believe communication skills and teamwork ability are crucial in the workplace.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得跳槽对职业发展有帮助吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think job-hopping is helpful for career development?

dialogues.cn: 适当的跳槽可以拓宽视野，但频繁跳槽可能会给雇主留下不稳定的印象。
dialogues.en: Moderate job-hopping can broaden your horizons, but frequent job-hopping may give employers the impression of instability.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待加班文化？
dialogues.en: How do you view overtime culture?

dialogues.cn: 偶尔加班是可以理解的，但长期过度加班会严重影响员工的身心健康。
dialogues.en: Occasional overtime is understandable, but long-term excessive overtime can seriously affect employees' physical and mental health.

dialogues.cn: 你认为学历和能力哪个更重要？
dialogues.en: Do you think educational background or ability is more important?

dialogues.cn: 学历是敲门砖，但在实际工作中，能力才是决定你能走多远的关键。
dialogues.en: Educational qualifications are a stepping stone, but in actual work, ability is the key to determining how far you can go.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得领导力是天生的还是后天培养的？
dialogues.en: Do you think leadership is innate or can be developed?

dialogues.cn: 我认为领导力虽然部分受性格影响，但主要还是可以通过学习和实践来培养。
dialogues.en: I believe that while leadership is partly influenced by personality, it can mainly be developed through learning and practice.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待远程办公这种工作方式？
dialogues.en: How do you view remote work as a way of working?

dialogues.cn: 远程办公可以提高灵活性和效率，但需要员工有较强的自我管理能力。
dialogues.en: Remote work can improve flexibility and efficiency, but it requires strong self-management skills from employees.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得现在找工作难吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think it's difficult to find a job now?

dialogues.cn: 竞争确实很激烈，但如果具备核心竞争力，机会还是很多的。
dialogues.en: The competition is indeed fierce, but if you have core competencies, there are still many opportunities.

dialogues.cn: 你认为什么行业未来发展前景最好？
dialogues.en: Which industry do you think has the best prospects for the future?

dialogues.cn: 人工智能、新能源和医疗健康行业的发展前景非常广阔。
dialogues.en: The development prospects of artificial intelligence, new energy, and healthcare industries are very promising.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得职场中人际关系重要吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think interpersonal relationships are important in the workplace?

dialogues.cn: 良好的人际关系有助于工作的顺利开展，但最终还是要把本职工作做好。
dialogues.en: Good interpersonal relationships help work go smoothly, but ultimately, you still need to do your job well.

dialogues.cn: 你对年轻人有什么职业建议？
dialogues.en: What career advice do you have for young people?

dialogues.cn: 我的建议是尽早了解自己的兴趣和优势，选择适合自己的职业方向并持续深耕。
dialogues.en: My advice is to understand your interests and strengths as early as possible, choose a career direction that suits you, and keep developing in it.

topics.topic: 全球化与文化交流 Globalization & Cultural Exchange

dialogues.cn: 你认为全球化对中国文化有什么影响？
dialogues.en: What impact do you think globalization has on Chinese culture?

dialogues.cn: 全球化在促进文化交流的同时，也让中国传统文化面临被同化的挑战。
dialogues.en: While globalization promotes cultural exchange, it also challenges traditional Chinese culture with the risk of assimilation.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待越来越多的外国人学习中文？
dialogues.en: How do you view the growing number of foreigners learning Chinese?

dialogues.cn: 这说明中国的国际影响力在不断提升，中华文化的吸引力越来越大。
dialogues.en: This shows that China's international influence is constantly rising and Chinese culture is becoming more attractive.

dialogues.cn: 你有没有和外国人交流的经历？
dialogues.en: Have you ever had the experience of communicating with foreigners?

dialogues.cn: 我曾在旅行中和来自不同国家的人交流，发现虽然文化不同，但大家有很多共同点。
dialogues.en: I once communicated with people from different countries during a trip and found that although cultures differ, we have many things in common.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得学好英语对个人发展有多重要？
dialogues.en: How important do you think learning English well is for personal development?

dialogues.cn: 英语作为国际通用语言，在职业发展和国际交流中都起着关键作用。
dialogues.en: As an international lingua franca, English plays a key role in career development and international communication.

dialogues.cn: 你认为国际文化交流最大的障碍是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the biggest barrier to international cultural exchange?

dialogues.cn: 语言障碍和文化偏见是国际文化交流中两个最大的障碍。
dialogues.en: Language barriers and cultural prejudice are the two biggest barriers to international cultural exchange.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待文化冲突？
dialogues.en: How do you view cultural conflicts?

dialogues.cn: 文化冲突往往是由于不了解对方的文化习惯造成的，加强交流可以有效减少冲突。
dialogues.en: Cultural conflicts are often caused by a lack of understanding of each other's cultural customs, and strengthening communication can effectively reduce conflicts.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得中国的春节有可能成为世界性的节日吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think the Chinese Spring Festival could become a global holiday?

dialogues.cn: 事实上，春节已经在很多国家得到了庆祝，这反映了中国文化的国际影响力。
dialogues.en: In fact, the Spring Festival is already celebrated in many countries, reflecting the international influence of Chinese culture.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待文化输出和文化自信之间的关系？
dialogues.en: How do you view the relationship between cultural export and cultural confidence?

dialogues.cn: 文化自信是文化输出的基础，只有对自己的文化充满自信，才能更好地向世界展示。
dialogues.en: Cultural confidence is the foundation of cultural export. Only when we are confident in our own culture can we present it better to the world.

dialogues.cn: 你认为国际学生交流项目有什么意义？
dialogues.en: What significance do you think international student exchange programs have?

dialogues.cn: 国际学生交流项目可以促进不同国家年轻人之间的相互了解和友谊。
dialogues.en: International student exchange programs can promote mutual understanding and friendship among young people from different countries.

dialogues.cn: 你认为一个好政府最重要的品质是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the most important quality of a good government?

dialogues.cn: 我认为透明度和问责制是现代政府最重要的品质，公信力建立在信息公开和承担责任的基础上。
dialogues.en: I believe transparency and accountability are the most important qualities of a modern government, as public trust is built on information openness and taking responsibility.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待政府在经济发展中的角色？
dialogues.en: How do you view the government's role in economic development?

dialogues.cn: 政府应该在宏观调控和市场监管方面发挥关键作用，同时给市场足够的空间来自我调节。
dialogues.en: The government should play a key role in macroeconomic regulation and market supervision while giving the market enough space for self-regulation.

dialogues.cn: 你认为医疗改革应该优先解决什么问题？
dialogues.en: What do you think should be the priority in healthcare reform?

dialogues.cn: 我认为应该首先解决医疗资源分配不均的问题，让基层医疗机构发挥更大的作用。
dialogues.en: I believe the priority should be addressing the uneven distribution of medical resources and enabling primary healthcare institutions to play a greater role.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得公共政策的制定应该更多地考虑哪些因素？
dialogues.en: What factors do you think should be considered more in public policy-making?

dialogues.cn: 公共政策的制定应该充分考虑社会公平性和可持续性，同时要听取各方意见。
dialogues.en: Public policy-making should fully consider social equity and sustainability while listening to opinions from all sides.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待大数据在社会治理中的应用？
dialogues.en: How do you view the application of big data in social governance?

dialogues.cn: 大数据可以帮助政府更精准地制定政策，但也需要加强数据安全和隐私保护。
dialogues.en: Big data can help the government formulate more precise policies, but data security and privacy protection also need to be strengthened.

dialogues.cn: 你认为环境立法应该更加严格吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think environmental legislation should be stricter?

dialogues.cn: 环境保护需要更严格的法律框架，同时也需要有配套的执法机制来确保法律的有效实施。
dialogues.en: Environmental protection requires a stricter legal framework, along with supporting enforcement mechanisms to ensure effective implementation.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待政府在缩小贫富差距方面的作用？
dialogues.en: How do you view the government's role in narrowing the wealth gap?

dialogues.cn: 通过税收调节、社会保障体系建设和教育公平化等手段，政府可以在一定程度上缩小贫富差距。
dialogues.en: Through tax adjustments, social security system construction, and educational equity, the government can narrow the wealth gap to some extent.

dialogues.cn: 你认为社区在社会治理中应该扮演什么角色？
dialogues.en: What role do you think communities should play in social governance?

dialogues.cn: 社区是社会治理的基本单元，应该鼓励居民参与社区事务，形成共建共治共享的格局。
dialogues.en: Communities are the basic unit of social governance. Residents should be encouraged to participate in community affairs, forming a pattern of joint construction, joint governance, and shared benefits.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得决策过程中公民参与有多重要？
dialogues.en: How important do you think citizen participation is in the decision-making process?

dialogues.cn: 公民参与是民主决策的重要组成部分，能够使政策更加贴近民众的实际需求。
dialogues.en: Citizen participation is an important part of democratic decision-making and can make policies more aligned with people's actual needs.

topics.topic: 哲学与价值观 Philosophy & Values

dialogues.cn: 你认为幸福是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think happiness is?

dialogues.cn: 幸福不是单纯拥有物质财富，而是内心的满足感和与他人的深层连接。
dialogues.en: Happiness is not simply about possessing material wealth, but rather a sense of inner fulfillment and deep connections with others.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得金钱和幸福之间有什么关系？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the relationship between money and happiness?

dialogues.cn: 金钱是保障基本生活的必要条件，但超过一定水平后，它对幸福感的提升是递减的。
dialogues.en: Money is a necessary condition for a basic standard of living, but beyond a certain level, its contribution to happiness diminishes.

dialogues.cn: 你认为人生的意义是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the meaning of life?

dialogues.cn: 每个人对人生的意义有不同的理解，我认为实现自我价值和对社会有所贡献是最有意义的。
dialogues.en: Everyone has a different understanding of the meaning of life. I believe realizing one's self-worth and contributing to society are the most meaningful.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待成功？
dialogues.en: How do you view success?

dialogues.cn: 成功不应该只用财富和地位来衡量，能在自己热爱的领域持续成长也是一种成功。
dialogues.en: Success should not be measured solely by wealth and status. Continuously growing in a field you are passionate about is also a form of success.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得现代社会人们最缺乏的是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think people in modern society lack the most?

dialogues.cn: 我认为现代人最缺乏的是内心的宁静和深度思考的能力，我们太容易被碎片化的信息分散注意力。
dialogues.en: I think modern people lack inner peace and the ability to think deeply the most. We are too easily distracted by fragmented information.

dialogues.cn: 你认为道德教育在现代社会中还重要吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think moral education is still important in modern society?

dialogues.cn: 道德教育在任何时候都不可忽视，它是一个社会文明程度的基础。
dialogues.en: Moral education should never be overlooked, as it is the foundation of a society's level of civilization.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待传统文化中的孝道？
dialogues.en: How do you view filial piety in traditional culture?

dialogues.cn: 孝道的核心是尊重和关爱父母，这种精神在任何时代都不会过时，但表达方式可以与时俱进。
dialogues.en: The core of filial piety is respecting and caring for parents. This spirit will never go out of date, but the way it is expressed can evolve with the times.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得独处重要吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think spending time alone is important?

dialogues.cn: 独处是自我反思和充电的重要方式，学会与自己相处对个人成长至关重要。
dialogues.en: Spending time alone is an important way to reflect and recharge. Learning to be comfortable with yourself is crucial for personal growth.

dialogues.cn: 你认为人应该追求什么样的生活？
dialogues.en: What kind of life do you think people should pursue?

dialogues.cn: 我认为人应该追求有意义且平衡的生活，在事业、家庭和个人成长之间找到属于自己的节奏。
dialogues.en: I believe people should pursue a meaningful and balanced life, finding their own rhythm among career, family, and personal growth.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待人与人之间的信任？
dialogues.en: How do you view trust between people?

dialogues.cn: 信任是所有人际关系的基石，建立信任需要很长时间，破坏信任却只在一瞬间。
dialogues.en: Trust is the cornerstone of all relationships. Building trust takes a long time, but destroying it only takes a moment.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得追求完美是一种好品质吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think pursuing perfection is a good quality?

dialogues.cn: 适度追求完美可以推动进步，但过度追求完美会导致焦虑和效率下降，重要的是把握好分寸。
dialogues.en: A moderate pursuit of perfection can drive progress, but excessive pursuit of perfection can lead to anxiety and decreased efficiency. The key is finding the right balance.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待心理咨询和心理治疗？
dialogues.en: How do you view psychological counseling and therapy?

dialogues.cn: 心理咨询和心理治疗是帮助人们应对心理困扰的专业手段，应该消除对它们的偏见。
dialogues.en: Psychological counseling and therapy are professional means of helping people cope with psychological distress. We should eliminate the stigma surrounding them.

dialogues.cn: 你认为当代年轻人面临的最大心理压力是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the biggest psychological pressure facing today's young people?

dialogues.cn: 社会期望过高和不确定的未来可能是当代年轻人最大的心理压力来源。
dialogues.en: Excessive social expectations and an uncertain future are probably the biggest sources of psychological pressure for today's young people.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待社交媒体对心理健康的影响？
dialogues.en: How do you view the impact of social media on mental health?

dialogues.cn: 社交媒体容易引发社交比较和焦虑，尤其对青少年的心理健康影响不容忽视。
dialogues.en: Social media can easily trigger social comparison and anxiety, and its impact on the mental health of young people especially cannot be ignored.

dialogues.cn: 你认为社会应该如何更好地支持有心理健康问题的人？
dialogues.en: How do you think society should better support people with mental health issues?

dialogues.cn: 需要建立更加完善的心理健康服务体系，同时在社会层面减少对心理疾病的污名化。
dialogues.en: We need to establish a more comprehensive mental health service system while reducing the social stigma associated with mental illness.

dialogues.cn: 你在感到焦虑时通常会怎么做？
dialogues.en: What do you usually do when you feel anxious?

dialogues.cn: 我会通过深呼吸和运动来缓解焦虑，同时试着将担忧的事情写下来，理清思路。
dialogues.en: I relieve anxiety through deep breathing and exercise, while also trying to write down the things I'm worried about to organize my thoughts.

dialogues.cn: 你认为正念冥想对缓解压力有效吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think mindfulness meditation is effective for stress relief?

dialogues.cn: 有研究表明正念冥想可以有效降低焦虑水平，提高注意力和情绪管理能力。
dialogues.en: Research shows that mindfulness meditation can effectively reduce anxiety levels and improve attention and emotional management skills.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得工作和生活的平衡对心理健康有多重要？
dialogues.en: How important do you think work-life balance is for mental health?

dialogues.cn: 工作和生活的平衡对心理健康至关重要，长期失衡会导致职业倦怠甚至抑郁。
dialogues.en: Work-life balance is crucial for mental health. Long-term imbalance can lead to burnout or even depression.

dialogues.cn: 你认为孩子从小应该接受情绪管理教育吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think children should receive emotional management education from a young age?

dialogues.cn: 情绪管理能力对一个人的成长至关重要，学校和家庭都应该重视孩子的情商培养。
dialogues.en: Emotional management ability is crucial for personal growth. Both schools and families should emphasize children's emotional intelligence development.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得社会对心理疾病的认知有改变吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think society's understanding of mental illness has changed?

dialogues.cn: 社会对心理疾病的认知正在逐步改善，但仍有很多人对心理问题存在误解和偏见。
dialogues.en: Society's understanding of mental illness is gradually improving, but many people still have misunderstandings and prejudice about mental health issues.

topics.topic: 媒体素养与信息辨别 Media Literacy & Information

dialogues.cn: 你觉得在信息爆炸的时代，如何提高信息辨别能力？
dialogues.en: How do you think we can improve our ability to distinguish information in an age of information explosion?

dialogues.cn: 我们需要培养批判性思维，学会多角度验证信息的来源和真实性。
dialogues.en: We need to develop critical thinking skills and learn to verify the source and authenticity of information from multiple angles.

dialogues.cn: 你认为算法推荐对人们获取信息有什么影响？
dialogues.en: What impact do you think algorithm recommendations have on people's access to information?

dialogues.cn: 算法推荐容易造成信息茧房，使人们只接触到与自己观点一致的信息。
dialogues.en: Algorithm recommendations can easily create information bubbles, causing people to only be exposed to information that aligns with their existing views.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得媒体在社会中应该承担什么责任？
dialogues.en: What responsibility do you think media should bear in society?

dialogues.cn: 媒体应该坚持真实、客观、公正的报道原则，为公众提供准确的信息。
dialogues.en: Media should adhere to the principles of truthfulness, objectivity, and fairness, providing accurate information to the public.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待短视频平台对年轻人的影响？
dialogues.en: How do you view the impact of short video platforms on young people?

dialogues.cn: 短视频平台丰富了娱乐方式，但过度使用可能导致注意力碎片化和信息浅层化。
dialogues.en: Short video platforms have enriched entertainment methods, but excessive use may lead to fragmented attention and shallow information consumption.

dialogues.cn: 你认为在数字时代保护个人隐私面临哪些挑战？
dialogues.en: What challenges do you think personal privacy protection faces in the digital age?

dialogues.cn: 个人数据被过度收集和滥用是数字时代最突出的隐私问题，需要完善法律来加强保护。
dialogues.en: Excessive collection and misuse of personal data is the most prominent privacy issue in the digital age, requiring improved laws for better protection.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待网红经济？
dialogues.en: How do you view the influencer economy?

dialogues.cn: 网红经济是一种新兴的商业模式，创造了就业机会，但也存在内容质量参差不齐的问题。
dialogues.en: The influencer economy is an emerging business model that creates job opportunities, but it also has issues with inconsistent content quality.

dialogues.cn: 你认为媒体素养教育应该从什么时候开始？
dialogues.en: When do you think media literacy education should begin?

dialogues.cn: 媒体素养教育应该从小学阶段就开始，帮助孩子从小建立正确的信息消费观念。
dialogues.en: Media literacy education should start from elementary school, helping children build correct concepts about information consumption from a young age.

dialogues.cn: 你认为社交媒体应该受到更严格的监管吗？
dialogues.en: Do you think social media should be subject to stricter regulation?

dialogues.cn: 社交媒体平台应该承担更多的内容审核责任，同时也要在保护言论自由和防止有害内容之间找到平衡。
dialogues.en: Social media platforms should take more responsibility for content moderation while also finding a balance between protecting free speech and preventing harmful content.

topics.topic: 复杂社会议题 Complex Social Issues

dialogues.cn: 你认为人工智能的快速发展是否会加剧社会不平等？
dialogues.en: Do you think the rapid development of artificial intelligence will exacerbate social inequality?

dialogues.cn: 这是一个多层面的问题。一方面，人工智能可能会取代一些低技能岗位，导致部分群体失业；另一方面，它也能创造新的机遇。关键在于政府和企业能否通过再培训计划和教育改革来弥合这一差距。
dialogues.en: This is a multifaceted issue. On one hand, AI may displace some low-skilled jobs, causing unemployment among certain groups; on the other hand, it can create new opportunities. The key lies in whether governments and businesses can bridge this gap through retraining programs and educational reforms.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待科技发展与伦理道德之间的冲突？
dialogues.en: How do you view the conflict between technological development and ethics?

dialogues.cn: 科技发展不应以牺牲伦理道德为代价。我们需要在推动技术进步的同时建立健全的伦理审查机制，确保技术服务于人类福祉而非反之。
dialogues.en: Technological development should not come at the expense of ethics. We need to establish robust ethical review mechanisms while promoting technological progress, ensuring that technology serves human well-being rather than the other way around.

dialogues.cn: 你认为全球治理面临的核心挑战是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think are the core challenges facing global governance?

dialogues.cn: 全球治理面临的核心挑战在于如何在尊重各国主权的前提下，建立有效的国际合作机制来应对气候变化、公共卫生和网络安全等跨国问题。
dialogues.en: The core challenge of global governance is how to establish effective international cooperation mechanisms to address cross-border issues like climate change, public health, and cybersecurity while respecting national sovereignty.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待代际差异对社会的影响？
dialogues.en: How do you view the impact of generational differences on society?

dialogues.cn: 代际差异是社会进步的动力之一，年轻一代带来新思维和新价值观，推动社会不断变革。但同时也需要加强代际对话，避免因观念差异导致社会分裂。
dialogues.en: Generational differences are one of the driving forces of social progress. Younger generations bring new thinking and values, driving continuous social change. But it's also necessary to strengthen intergenerational dialogue to avoid social divisions caused by differences in perspectives.

dialogues.cn: 你认为教育公平的最大障碍是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the biggest obstacle to educational equity?

dialogues.cn: 教育资源分配不均衡是最大的障碍，包括城乡差距、地区差距和校际差距。技术可以成为缩小教育差距的工具，但需要配套的政策支持和基础设施建设。
dialogues.en: Unequal distribution of educational resources is the biggest obstacle, including gaps between urban and rural areas, regions, and schools. Technology can be a tool for narrowing educational gaps, but it requires supporting policy and infrastructure development.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待数据隐私和公共安全之间的平衡？
dialogues.en: How do you view the balance between data privacy and public safety?

dialogues.cn: 这是一个需要精细权衡的问题。公共安全固然重要，但不能以全面牺牲个人隐私为代价。应该建立透明的数据使用规范和独立的监督机制。
dialogues.en: This is an issue that requires careful balancing. Public safety is certainly important, but it should not come at the cost of fully sacrificing personal privacy. Transparent data usage standards and independent oversight mechanisms should be established.

dialogues.cn: 你认为可持续发展目标在发展中国家的实施面临哪些主要障碍？
dialogues.en: What are the main obstacles to implementing sustainable development goals in developing countries?

dialogues.cn: 主要障碍包括资金不足、技术能力有限和制度建设不完善。此外，发达国家在提供技术和资金援助方面的承诺落实不到位也是一个重要因素。
dialogues.en: The main obstacles include insufficient funding, limited technological capacity, and underdeveloped institutional frameworks. Additionally, inadequate fulfillment of commitments by developed countries in providing technical and financial assistance is also a significant factor.

dialogues.cn: 你如何评价当前的国际合作机制在应对全球性挑战方面的有效性？
dialogues.en: How would you evaluate the effectiveness of current international cooperation mechanisms in addressing global challenges?

dialogues.cn: 现有的国际合作机制虽然在一定程度上促进了各国间的协调，但在应对气候变化和公共卫生危机等紧迫议题时，执行力和响应速度仍有待提升。
dialogues.en: While existing international cooperation mechanisms have facilitated coordination among countries to some extent, their execution capacity and response speed still need to be improved when addressing urgent issues like climate change and public health crises.

dialogues.cn: 你认为文化多元主义和国家认同之间是否存在根本性矛盾？
dialogues.en: Do you think there is a fundamental contradiction between cultural pluralism and national identity?

dialogues.cn: 两者之间并不存在不可调和的矛盾。一个成熟的社会应该能够在维护国家认同的同时尊重和包容文化多样性，关键在于构建共享的核心价值观。
dialogues.en: There is no irreconcilable contradiction between the two. A mature society should be able to respect and embrace cultural diversity while maintaining national identity. The key lies in building shared core values.

dialogues.cn: 你认为社会流动性的下降对一个国家的长期发展意味着什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think declining social mobility means for a country's long-term development?

dialogues.cn: 社会流动性下降可能导致阶层固化和社会活力减弱。长此以往，不仅会加剧社会不平等，还可能引发社会不稳定因素，因此需要通过政策手段创造更多公平的上升通道。
dialogues.en: Declining social mobility may lead to class stratification and reduced social vitality. In the long run, this could not only exacerbate social inequality but also create social instability. Therefore, policy measures are needed to create more equitable pathways for upward mobility.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待自由与秩序之间的关系？
dialogues.en: How do you view the relationship between freedom and order?

dialogues.cn: 自由和秩序并非对立面，而是相互依存的。没有秩序保障的自由会导致混乱，而没有自由的秩序则会沦为压制。真正的挑战在于找到两者之间的最佳平衡点。
dialogues.en: Freedom and order are not opposites but are interdependent. Freedom without the guarantee of order leads to chaos, while order without freedom becomes oppression. The real challenge is finding the optimal balance between the two.

dialogues.cn: 你认为知识与智慧之间有什么区别？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the difference between knowledge and wisdom?

dialogues.cn: 知识是对事实和信息的掌握，而智慧则是运用知识做出正确判断和决策的能力。在信息唾手可得的时代，智慧远比知识更加珍贵。
dialogues.en: Knowledge is the mastery of facts and information, while wisdom is the ability to use knowledge to make sound judgments and decisions. In an age where information is readily available, wisdom is far more valuable than knowledge.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待历史对当下的启示？
dialogues.en: How do you view the lessons of history for the present?

dialogues.cn: 历史虽然不会简单重复，但往往押着相同的韵脚。通过理解历史规律，我们可以更好地预判趋势、避免重蹈覆辙，但也不能机械地用历史经验套用到当下。
dialogues.en: While history does not simply repeat itself, it often rhymes. By understanding historical patterns, we can better anticipate trends and avoid repeating past mistakes, but we should not mechanically apply historical experiences to the present.

dialogues.cn: 你认为标准化教育和个性化教育哪个更适合当今社会？
dialogues.en: Do you think standardized education or personalized education is more suitable for today's society?

dialogues.cn: 两者并非非此即彼的关系。标准化教育确保了基本的教育质量和平等的受教育机会，而个性化教育则能更好地发掘每个学生的潜能。理想的教育体系应该在两者之间取得平衡。
dialogues.en: The two are not mutually exclusive. Standardized education ensures basic educational quality and equal access to education, while personalized education can better unlock each student's potential. An ideal education system should balance the two.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待科技进步带来的伦理困境？
dialogues.en: How do you view the ethical dilemmas brought about by technological progress?

dialogues.cn: 技术本身是中性的，关键在于人类如何使用它。面对基因编辑、自动驾驶等新技术带来的伦理困境，需要科学家、伦理学家和政策制定者共同参与讨论，建立前瞻性的治理框架。
dialogues.en: Technology itself is neutral; the key lies in how humans use it. When facing ethical dilemmas brought by new technologies like gene editing and autonomous driving, scientists, ethicists, and policymakers need to participate in discussions together and establish forward-looking governance frameworks.

dialogues.cn: 你认为同理心在现代社会中是否被低估了？
dialogues.en: Do you think empathy is underestimated in modern society?

dialogues.cn: 在竞争日益激烈的社会环境中，同理心确实常常被忽视。然而，同理心是构建和谐社会的基石，它能促进人与人之间的理解和信任，也有助于更全面地看待和解决问题。
dialogues.en: In an increasingly competitive social environment, empathy is indeed often overlooked. However, empathy is the cornerstone of building a harmonious society. It promotes understanding and trust between people and helps view and solve problems more comprehensively.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待确定性与不确定性对人生选择的影响？
dialogues.en: How do you view the impact of certainty and uncertainty on life choices?

dialogues.cn: 追求确定性是人的本能，但过度追求确定性可能会错失许多成长的机会。学会拥抱不确定性、在不确定中寻找方向，反而可能带来意想不到的收获。
dialogues.en: Pursuing certainty is human instinct, but excessive pursuit of certainty may cause you to miss many opportunities for growth. Learning to embrace uncertainty and find direction within it can actually bring unexpected rewards.

dialogues.cn: 你认为社会进步的衡量标准应该是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think should be the criteria for measuring social progress?

dialogues.cn: 社会进步不应仅以经济指标来衡量，还应包括公民权利的保障程度、社会公平性、环境可持续性以及人民的整体幸福感等多个维度。
dialogues.en: Social progress should not be measured solely by economic indicators, but should also include the protection of civil rights, social equity, environmental sustainability, and the overall happiness of the people, among other dimensions.

dialogues.cn: 你认为失败对于个人成长有多大的价值？
dialogues.en: How much value do you think failure has for personal growth?

dialogues.cn: 失败是最深刻的老师之一。它能迫使我们重新审视自己的方法和假设，培养韧性和适应能力。真正定义一个人的不是他失败了多少次，而是他如何从失败中学习并重新站起来。
dialogues.en: Failure is one of the most profound teachers. It forces us to re-examine our methods and assumptions, cultivating resilience and adaptability. What truly defines a person is not how many times they fail, but how they learn from failure and rise again.

dialogues.cn: 你觉得当代社会最被忽视的价值观是什么？
dialogues.en: What do you think is the most overlooked value in contemporary society?

dialogues.cn: 我认为是耐心。在追求即时满足和效率至上的社会氛围中，我们逐渐失去了对深度学习、深度关系和长期积累的耐心，而恰恰是这些需要时间沉淀的事物才最有价值。
dialogues.en: I believe it's patience. In a social atmosphere that pursues instant gratification and prioritizes efficiency, we are gradually losing patience for deep learning, deep relationships, and long-term accumulation, while it is precisely these things that require time to develop that are most valuable.

dialogues.cn: 你认为未来的城市规划应该如何应对气候变化？
dialogues.en: How do you think future urban planning should address climate change?

dialogues.cn: 未来城市规划需要将气候韧性纳入核心考量，包括建设海绵城市以应对极端降雨、增加城市绿地面积以缓解热岛效应、推广绿色建筑标准以降低碳排放，以及发展公共交通以减少私人汽车的依赖。
dialogues.en: Future urban planning needs to incorporate climate resilience as a core consideration, including building sponge cities to cope with extreme rainfall, increasing urban green spaces to mitigate the heat island effect, promoting green building standards to reduce carbon emissions, and developing public transportation to reduce dependence on private cars.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待人工智能在创意产业中的应用？
dialogues.en: How do you view the application of artificial intelligence in creative industries?

dialogues.cn: 人工智能在创意产业中的应用引发了关于原创性和知识产权的深刻讨论。我认为AI更适合作为创意工作者的辅助工具，帮助拓展思路和提高效率，但最终的创意判断和情感表达仍然需要人类的参与。
dialogues.en: The application of AI in creative industries has sparked profound discussions about originality and intellectual property. I believe AI is better suited as an assistive tool for creative professionals, helping to expand ideas and improve efficiency, but the final creative judgment and emotional expression still require human involvement.

dialogues.cn: 你认为当前的全球供应链存在哪些结构性风险？
dialogues.en: What structural risks do you think exist in the current global supply chain?

dialogues.cn: 全球供应链过度集中在某些区域和环节，使得其在面对地缘政治冲突、自然灾害和公共卫生危机时极为脆弱。分散化和多元化是降低供应链风险的关键策略。
dialogues.en: Global supply chains are overly concentrated in certain regions and stages, making them extremely vulnerable to geopolitical conflicts, natural disasters, and public health crises. Diversification and decentralization are key strategies for reducing supply chain risks.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待企业在社会责任方面应承担的角色？
dialogues.en: How do you view the role that enterprises should play in social responsibility?

dialogues.cn: 企业不应仅追求利润最大化，还应将社会责任融入其核心战略。这不仅有助于企业建立长期的品牌信誉，也是推动社会可持续发展的重要力量。
dialogues.en: Enterprises should not solely pursue profit maximization but should integrate social responsibility into their core strategies. This not only helps companies build long-term brand reputation but also serves as an important force for driving sustainable social development.

dialogues.cn: 你认为医疗技术的突破将如何改变未来的医疗模式？
dialogues.en: How do you think breakthroughs in medical technology will change the future of healthcare?

dialogues.cn: 精准医疗、基因疗法和远程医疗等技术突破将使医疗服务更加个性化和高效。未来医疗模式可能会从以治疗为中心转向以预防和健康管理为中心，这对降低整体医疗成本和提高人民生活质量都有深远意义。
dialogues.en: Breakthroughs in precision medicine, gene therapy, and telemedicine will make healthcare more personalized and efficient. The future healthcare model may shift from being treatment-centered to prevention and health management-centered, which has profound significance for reducing overall healthcare costs and improving people's quality of life.

dialogues.cn: 你认为量子计算一旦成熟将对社会产生怎样的影响？
dialogues.en: What impact do you think quantum computing will have on society once it matures?

dialogues.cn: 量子计算的成熟将彻底改变密码学、药物研发和气候模拟等领域的格局。但与此同时，它也可能对现有的数据安全体系构成威胁，需要提前做好后量子密码学的准备。
dialogues.en: The maturation of quantum computing will fundamentally transform fields like cryptography, drug development, and climate simulation. However, it may also pose threats to existing data security systems, necessitating advance preparation with post-quantum cryptography.

dialogues.cn: 你怎么看待太空探索对人类未来的意义？
dialogues.en: How do you view the significance of space exploration for humanity's future?

dialogues.cn: 太空探索不仅是科学好奇心的体现，更关乎人类的长远生存。资源开发、行星殖民以及对宇宙更深入的理解都可能成为确保人类文明延续的关键。在太空探索过程中产生的技术创新也往往能惠及日常生活。
dialogues.en: Space exploration is not just a manifestation of scientific curiosity but is also crucial for humanity's long-term survival. Resource development, planetary colonization, and a deeper understanding of the universe could all become key to ensuring the continuation of human civilization. Technological innovations resulting from space exploration often benefit everyday life as well.

dialogues.cn: 你认为未来的能源结构会是什么样的？
dialogues.en: What do you think the future energy structure will look like?

dialogues.cn: 未来的能源结构将以可再生能源为主体，核聚变如果实现商业化突破将彻底改变能源格局。储能技术的进步和智能电网的建设将是实现能源转型的关键。
dialogues.en: The future energy structure will be dominated by renewable energy, and if nuclear fusion achieves a commercial breakthrough, it will completely transform the energy landscape. Advances in energy storage technology and the construction of smart grids will be key to achieving energy transformation.

dialogues.cn: 你如何看待人文学科在科技时代的价值？
dialogues.en: How do you view the value of humanities in the age of technology?

dialogues.cn: 在科技飞速发展的时代，人文学科的价值不仅没有减弱，反而更加凸显。它培养的批判性思维、伦理判断和对人类经验的深层理解，正是引导科技向善发展所不可或缺的。技术需要人文精神的引领。
dialogues.en: In an era of rapid technological development, the value of the humanities has not diminished but has actually become more prominent. The critical thinking, ethical judgment, and deep understanding of human experience it cultivates are indispensable for guiding technology toward the greater good. Technology needs the guidance of humanistic spirit.

9. 找语伴一起练习对话，模拟真实场景
10. 定期复习已学过的内容，防止遗忘
